# OpenTokenUsage

> OpenTokenUsage is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows 11 tray app that shows how much of your AI coding subscriptions you've used: session (5-hour) and weekly limits, credits, reset times and pace, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and 12 more providers. It is the Windows counterpart of macOS menu bar apps like CodexBar and OpenUsage.

- Platform: Windows 11 only (no macOS or Linux build).
- Install: `winget install PowerUserZ.OpenTokenUsage`, or the installer from GitHub Releases. The app updates itself.
- Price: free. No account, no telemetry; logins stay on the PC.
- How it works: it reuses the login of each tool you already use (for example Claude Code or the Codex CLI) and asks that provider for your usage. No API keys to paste for Claude or Codex.
- Providers: Claude, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Amp, Devin, Factory (Droid), Grok, JetBrains AI Assistant, Kimi Code, Kiro, MiniMax, OpenCode Go, Synthetic, Z.ai.
- Shows: used percent, reset time, pace (ahead or behind an even pace), and when you'll run out at the current rate.
- Alerts: Windows notifications at chosen usage levels (80% and 95% by default), pace warnings and resets, with built-in or custom sounds.
- Tray: app icon, percent, bars, or one number or logo ring per provider; an experimental taskbar strip shows session and weekly numbers inside the taskbar.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish, Simplified Chinese.
- Local HTTP API: other apps on the same PC can read usage from 127.0.0.1:6736 (loopback only).

## Docs

- [Claude provider](https://github.com/PowerUserZ/OpenTokenUsage/blob/main/docs/providers/claude.md): session, weekly and model limits, extra usage, local token spend
- [Codex provider](https://github.com/PowerUserZ/OpenTokenUsage/blob/main/docs/providers/codex.md): 5-hour and weekly limits, code reviews, credits
- [Cursor provider](https://github.com/PowerUserZ/OpenTokenUsage/blob/main/docs/providers/cursor.md)
